name: Spotify
label: 25 friends and a dream
summary: Anyone can make an app in minutes. Whether you can serve more than a few dozen users is a review Spotify runs on commercial grounds, and its rules were in flux in 2026.
verdict: Minutes to build, 25 invited users to test with. Going wider is a review Spotify runs on commercial grounds.
blocker: Development mode caps you at an invited-user list. Going past it means a quota-extension review that weighs commercial interest.

steps.title: Live in Development mode first
steps.detail: A 2021 Spotify post says new apps start here, with full Web API access and up to 25 invited users listed in the dashboard.

steps.title: Request Extended Quota Mode
steps.detail: Per the same post: Spotify reviews and tests the app, wants a working demo, and considers commercial interest and monetisation. Scopes are then locked to what was approved.

steps.title: Check what changed in 2026
steps.detail: Spotify announced an update to developer access in February 2026 and a community thread discusses it. We could read the thread's header but not the post, so the current user limits and thresholds are unknown.
